wedo_instance.description: The synchronized collaboration HUD for agent incarnation, forensic mapping, and Heartwood alignment.

tasks.description: Absolute Mapping: Execute 'verify_environment.py' and 'metagit_map.py' to anchor the meta-root DNS.
Relative Mapping: Execute 'metagit_git_map.py' and 'send_swarm_message.py' to announce existence and resolve local substrate.
Identity Anchoring: Run 'register_agent.py' to choose unique name (Orestes), anchor screen title, and sync git attribution.
Heartwood Contextualization: Load 'public/json/' (Trunk, Logic, Schema) into active session context.
Forensic Trace: Reconstruct the 'Active Mission' from recent snapshots and previous session logs.
HUD Display & Halt: Print structured Bootup Report and await human signature.
